name: SalesAutopilot
description: SalesAutopilot is a marketing automation platform for managing email campaigns, customer relationships, and sales workflows.

events.d: Add a subscriber to a list through a signup form with email, name, company and other fields.
Find subscribers in a list by ID or field value, or list every subscriber of the list.
Permanently delete a subscriber from a list by subscriber ID.
Find products by name or SKU, filter by category, paginate results, or select response fields.
List the subscribers of a subscriber list, optionally filtered by segment or status.
List the saved segments of a subscriber list, optionally including archived segments.
List the product categories of your SalesAutopilot account. Use the category ID with the Find Products action.
